children: Flowers for the days you’ll never forget
An artful boutique studio for weddings and events — seasonal, locally grown, and designed around your story from the very first bloom.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: We design with what’s at its best right now, sourced from growers we know — so your flowers are fresher, richer, and truly of the season.
Beyond the bouquet: arches, installations, tablescapes and every last detail, imagined as one considered whole and installed on the day.
From an intimate elopement to a two-hundred-seat reception, we design at any scale with the same care for the moment it marks.
We deliver, place and style everything ourselves, then quietly return to strike it down — so your day stays entirely yours.

children: We design the way flowers grow — loose, textured, a little untamed — never stiff or symmetrical for its own sake. The result feels gathered that morning, because much of it was.
Working in season keeps every arrangement honest: garden roses in June, dahlias in September, ranunculus in spring. It’s the reason our work always looks like the moment it’s made for.

children: “We handed Wildstem a Pinterest board and a wedding date and got back something better than we could have described. Walking into that reception — the arch, the tables, the light through it all — we both just stopped. It was us, in flowers.”

pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: Who Wildstem Floral is, what we do and the people behind the work.

children.class: mx-auto grid w-full max-w-5xl items-center gap-10 @3xl:grid-cols-2 @3xl:gap-16

attrs.alt: A lush, romantic bridal bouquet of garden roses and trailing greenery

children: Wildstem began at a single farm stand — a bucket of just-cut stems, sold to neighbours on a Saturday. What grew from it is a small studio devoted to the flowers that mark the biggest days of your life.

We stayed deliberately boutique so every couple and host works directly with the designer making their flowers. Fewer weddings a season, more attention on each — and arrangements that could only have been made for you.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-5xl flex-col gap-10

children: Every project opens with a real conversation — your date, your palette, the feeling you’re after — before a single stem is chosen.
We build around what’s at its peak and grown nearby, so your flowers are their most beautiful and their most yours.
Delivery, placement, styling and strike-down are ours to manage — you simply arrive to a room already in bloom.
